projects.title: Procurement holds reporting
projects.summary: Rebuilding spreadsheet reporting in Power BI, with separate views for the latest reporting week and historical trends.
projects.context: A procurement reporting process needed to retain its existing history while transitioning future reporting to automated weekly data. The model must distinguish current position metrics from changes across reporting weeks.
contributions: Reviewed the existing workbook and agreed an approach to preserve historical reporting while introducing new weekly sources.
Created history and latest snapshot queries, reviewed table relationships and resolved import, empty table and cyclic reference issues.
Reviewed DAX measures for source dependencies, reporting grain and consistent metric definitions.
Investigated repeated purchase order records to distinguish expected relationships where one record links to several others from possible duplication.
Reviewed currency mappings and conversion consistency, then coordinated reconciliation and stakeholder validation.
deliverables: Power BI model with history and latest snapshot queries
Overview and weekly trend measures under validation
Data quality and duplicate record assessment
projects.outcome: The source transition and weekly snapshot process are in place. Model cleanup, measure review, currency validation and stakeholder acceptance remain in progress as of 23 September 2026.
nextSteps: Validate current period totals and comparable weekly trends.
Resolve outstanding data quality and currency mapping questions.
Complete approval, refresh and release checks.

projects.title: Weekly reporting snapshot automation
projects.summary: Preserving dated weekly source files so reporting can show a reliable history alongside the latest available position.
projects.context: Replacing source files each week loses the evidence needed for trend reporting. The reporting workflow needed to collect current inputs without overwriting earlier reporting periods.
contributions: Updated a Power Automate process to collect the latest source files and create dated copies in SharePoint.
Expanded the flow to cover a source structure containing multiple files while retaining earlier weekly files.
Built Power Query steps to combine matching files and identify their reporting dates.
Added empty source checks and separate latest snapshot queries for current position reporting.
Confirmed successful flow runs after the source update and identified ongoing validation needs.
deliverables: Latest snapshot queries and empty input checks
projects.outcome: The updated automation has run successfully and preserves weekly files. Monitoring and reporting validation continue.
nextSteps: Monitor scheduled runs and source completeness.
Validate that new reporting weeks appear correctly in both current and trend views.

projects.title: PDF email workflow troubleshooting
projects.summary: Investigating an automation that sends an extra email with an empty or incorrectly named PDF attachment.
projects.context: A document workflow was producing the required PDF email as well as an unwanted second output. The investigation focused on identifying the branch responsible for the incorrect attachment.
contributions: Reviewed flow branches, document generation actions, attachment names and email actions.
Compared the incorrect output with the required summary PDF.
Reviewed the branch responsible for the incorrect output while preserving the required document path.
Defined a controlled test to verify the final email count, attachment name and document content.
projects.outcome: The issue is under review. A successful complete correction is not yet recorded in the latest work update.
nextSteps: Run a controlled test confirming one email with the correct attachment and content.
